name: RULE_WINDOWS Bucket Janitor
description: Sweeps fully-expired keys from the RULE_WINDOWS KV bucket. REQUIRED if any rule uses count_in_window operator — otherwise the bucket grows unboundedly with stale dimensions that received traffic once and then went silent. The janitor fires Sweep() on the WindowTracker, which deletes keys whose most-recent bucket is older than 24 hours. Keys with live traffic are never deleted.
